name: me-tax-overview
description: A one-page map of the Montenegrin tax system for tax year 2026, read from the laws published in the Official Gazette and on gov.me. Covers the calendar tax year, the euro, the Tax Administration (Poreska uprava) and its IRMS portal, who is resident, personal income tax at 0%, 9% and 15% (monthly salary bands EUR 700 and 1,000; annual business bands EUR 8,400 and 12,000), 15% on most other income and 12% on gambling winnings from 21 May 2026, the municipal surtax caps, corporate profit tax at 9%, 12% and 15% (bands EUR 100,000 and 1,500,000), withholding at 15% and 30%, VAT at 21%, 15%, 7% and 0% with EUR 30,000 registration, social contribution rates, the main filing deadlines and late-payment interest. Use for 'how does tax work in Montenegro', 'Montenegro tax overview', 'Montenegro tax rates 2026'. Detail sits in montenegro-income-tax, me-corporate-income-tax, montenegro-vat, montenegro-social-contributions, montenegro-payroll, me-cross-border, me-transfer-pricing and me-company-form
